title: Ember Orchard: The Sentinel's Seed Archive
premise: In a volcanic garden whose fruit germinates in cooling ash, the sentinel must escort witnesses through guarded crossings using a oath-bound signal shield.
ending: Recover the Seed Archive and return with the civilian refuge record; Orchard Keepers can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive thermal surge while evading the ashwood guardian without sacrificing the civilian refuge record.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Orchard Keepers to witness the oath-bound signal shield.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to stand guard or pursue the artifact
